items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: Now, I know a fellow by the the name of Harper that played with Louis Armstrong back in 26 or Armstrong back in 26 or 27

ctx.x: Well, as you're playing, you're listening to all the other instruments.

Oh, yeah. Well, when you're playing, if I'm playing too loud, in fact, if I'm playing so I can't hear the man sitting third to me, I'm playing too loud. And then another thing, you find thousands of musicians that are musically deaf. Seems like it sometimes. Now, I know a fellow by the the name of Harper that played with Louis Armstrong back in 26 or Armstrong back in 26 or 27, I don't remember which it was, but that man was musically deaf. And he had to always play under the other fella to keep from overplaying…
